read.thesis: NextEra's FY25 adjusted EPS rose 8.2% to $3.71 with 13.5 GW of new origination and a ~30 GW backlog, while the 2026 EPS guide of $3.92–$4.02 and 8%+ CAGR were reaffirmed unchanged.

capex.quote: FPL expects to invest between $90 billion and $100 billion through 2032 to support Florida’s continued growth

triggers.label: Origination 13.5 GW in 2025
triggers.quote: adding approximately 13.5 gigawatts to its backlog, including a record quarter of origination of approximately 3.6 GW

triggers.label: 2026 EPS guide reaffirmed $3.92–$4.02
triggers.quote: NextEra Energy continues to expect 2026 adjusted earnings per share to be in the range of $3.92 to $4.02

guidance.quote: NextEra Energy continues to expect 2026 adjusted earnings per share to be in the range of $3.92 to $4.02
We expect to grow adjusted earnings per share at a compound annual growth rate of 8%+ through 2032
FPL expects to invest between $90 billion and $100 billion through 2032
NextEra Energy also continues to expect to grow its dividends per share at a roughly 10% rate per year through 2026

prior_guidance_check.quote: exceeding the top end of the range we communicated in December

red_flags.label: GAAP EPS well below adjusted ($3.30 vs $3.71)
red_flags.quote: net income attributable to NextEra Energy on a GAAP basis of $6.835 billion, or $3.30 per share
